definitions.explanation: A person or thing being considered for selection.

examples.english: To be nominated as a candidate.

examples.japanese: {次期|じき}{社長|しゃちょう}の{候補|こうほ}として、3{名|めい}の{名前|なまえ}が{挙|あ}がっている。
examples.english: Three names have been put forward as candidates for the next company president.

notes:
{候補|こうほ} refers to candidates or options.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {候補|こうほ}に{挙|あ}がる (to be nominated)
- {候補|こうほ}を{絞|しぼ}る (to narrow down candidates)
- {候補|こうほ}から{外|はず}れる (to drop out of candidacy)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {候補者|こうほしゃ} (candidate - person)
- {候補|こうほ}{地|ち} (candidate site)
- {立候補|りっこうほ} (running for office)
